name: Teen Do Panch
description: Teen Do Panch (3-2-5, 5-3-2) is a three-player trick-taking game popular in India, Pakistan, and Nepal. 30-card deck (remove 2â€“6, keep only 7â™¥ and 7â™ ). Rank A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7. Each player has a trick quota: right of dealer 5, left 3, dealer 2. Deal 5-3-2 to each; first player chooses trump or next 3 cards decide. Follow suit, trump or discard. Ten tricks; score = tricks won minus quota. Card-pulling: players who exceeded quota steal one card per extra trick from those short.
